_readme: Literal text in the design that is really data, mapped to a binding name.
The importer replaces each exact (trimmed) text node with that binding, so
studio-adapter.js can supply the real value.
This is a patch over a design problem, not the fix. The proper fix is to make
these bindings in the Claude Design project -- see DESIGN-GAPS.md. When that
happens the literal stops appearing, the override stops matching, and
`npm run design:import` reports it as unused so the entry can be deleted.
